sponsored.t: Provides limitations on overlapping control between insurance companies and pharmacy benefits managers and pharmacies
sponsored.sum: Provides limitations on overlapping control between insurance companies and pharmacy benefits managers and pharmacies; requires divestment of the interest in one or more insurance companies and pharmacy benefits managers; prohibits insurance companies, pharmacies, and pharmacy benefit managers found in violation of such provisions from receiving payment from certain state programs.

sponsored.t: Relates to health insurance and provider divestment
sponsored.sum: Provides that it is unlawful for any person to directly or indirectly own, operate, or control the whole or any part of a health insurance company and a health care provider; requires divestment within three years; prohibits health insurance companies and health care providers found in violation of such provisions from receiving payment from certain state programs.

sponsored.t: Establishes a school speed zone camera demonstration program in the city of Poughkeepsie
sponsored.sum: Establishes a school speed zone camera demonstration program in the city of Poughkeepsie; repeals authorization of program December 31, 2030.

sponsored.t: Relates to adjudications and owner liability for a violation of traffic-control signal indications in the city of Poughkeepsie
sponsored.sum: Relates to adjudications and owner liability for a violation of traffic-control signal indications in the city of Poughkeepsie.

sponsored.t: Relates to the validity of ballots
sponsored.sum: Provides that tearing a ballot does not render it void.

sponsored.t: Requires elections and terms of certain officials occur on even-numbered years except in the city of New York
sponsored.sum: Requires certain elections take place in even-numbered years for certain municipal and judicial officials except in the city of New York.

sponsored.t: Extends the authority of the city of Poughkeepsie to impose a hotel and motel tax for an additional 2 years
sponsored.sum: Extends the authority of the city of Poughkeepsie to impose a hotel and motel tax for an additional three years.

sponsored.t: Rededicates the Franklin Delano Roosevelt Mid-Hudson bridge to Franklin and Eleanor Roosevelt
sponsored.sum: Rededicates the Franklin Delano Roosevelt Mid-Hudson bridge to Franklin and Eleanor Roosevelt.

sponsored.t: Extends the authorization of the city of Beacon to impose a hotel and motel tax for an additional two years
sponsored.sum: Extends the authorization of the city of Beacon to impose a hotel and motel tax for an additional three years.

sponsored.t: Relates to removing residency requirements for Ulster county assistant district attorneys
sponsored.sum: Removes residency requirements for persons holding the office of assistant district attorney for the county of Ulster; provides that a person holding such office may reside in Ulster county or an adjoining county within the state.

sponsored.t: Establishes a real property tax exemption for certain property owners who reside full-time on such property in certain counties
sponsored.sum: Establishes a real property tax exemption for certain property owners who reside full-time on such property in certain counties; requires that such owners occupy such property as their primary residence and are enrolled in or eligible for the STAR exemption or credit or that such owners rent to a tenant for a term of at least twelve months and such tenant occupies such property as their primary residence.

sponsored.t: Provides notice regarding the timeliness of the receipt by the board of elections of ballots capable of return by mail
sponsored.sum: Provides notice regarding the timeliness of the receipt by the board of elections of ballots capable of return by mail to advise voters that such ballot should be returned to the board of elections as soon as possible by any approved method, and further recommend the use of alternative methods of return besides domestic mail services if the voter will be returning their ballot within several days of the election.

sponsored.t: Prohibits utility corporations and municipalities from increasing a bill previously rendered to a small non-residential customer after twelve months from the date service was provided
sponsored.sum: Prohibits utility corporations and municipalities from increasing a bill previously rendered to a small non-residential customer after twelve months from the date service was provided; provides limited exceptions to such prohibition; requires the utility corporation or municipality to provide notice regarding the late billing.

sponsored.t: Relates to health care payment amounts
sponsored.sum: Requires an insurance company which owns a health care provider to pay any health care provider which it does not own an amount that is no less than the amount that it pays a health care provider which it does own for a comparable service; prohibits an insurance company which is owned by a health care provider from paying any health care provider which does not own such insurance company an amount that is less than the amount that it pays a health care provider which does own such company for a comparable service.

sponsored.t: Requires electric corporations and gas corporations to provide, as part of every billing statement, a tariff cost estimate in a clear, conspicuous and easily understandable manner
sponsored.sum: Requires electric corporations and gas corporations to provide, as part of every billing statement, a tariff cost estimate in a clear, conspicuous and easily understandable manner; requires such corporations to include an itemized disclosure of the primary cost components comprising the delivery portion of the bill.

sponsored.t: Relates to disability retirement benefits for the presumption of cancer affecting the endocrine and thyroid systems and Parkinson's Disease for certain firefighters
sponsored.sum: Relates to disability retirement benefits for the presumption of cancer affecting the endocrine and thyroid systems and Parkinson's Disease for certain firefighters.

sponsored.t: Relates to denials of increased utility rates and charges
sponsored.sum: Provides that whenever the public service commission denies a request by a utility for a major change in rates or charges, the schedule, rate, charge, form of contract or agreement, rule, regulation, general privilege, facility, or service immediately in effect prior to such request shall remain in full force and effect until such time as the commission approves a new rate, charge.

sponsored.t: Relates to the qualification of an applicant for the New York opportunity promise scholarship
sponsored.sum: Removes the requirement that an applicant for the New York opportunity promise scholarship has not already obtained any postsecondary degree.

sponsored.t: Establishes the consolidated lead-contaminated water supply line replacement program; repealer; appropriation
sponsored.sum: Establishes the consolidated lead-contaminated water supply line replacement program to provide financial assistance and reimbursement to municipalities for the abatement, removal and replacement of lead-contaminated water supply lines; establishes the consolidated lead-contaminated water supply line replacement fund; makes an appropriation of $500,000,000 to reimburse municipalities for such remediation, removal and replacement of lead-contaminated water supply lines; repeals certain provisions of law relating thereto.

sponsored.t: Establishes standards for the closure of banking accounts in the state of New York
sponsored.sum: Establishes standards for the closure of bank accounts in the state of New York to include providing notice of closure and the return of funds to account owners.

sponsored.t: Relates to certain mandatory disclosures for job advertisements
sponsored.sum: Requires certain mandatory disclosures for printed or digital job advertisements by an employer or third-party job posting entity; provides for the imposition of a fine of $2,500 for violations.

sponsored.t: Directs the department of transportation and certain public authorities to study certain bridges spanning bodies of water connected to deep water ports in the state
sponsored.sum: Directs the Department of Transportation, the Bridge Authority, the Triborough Bridge and Tunnel authority, the Thruway authority, and the Port Authority of New York and New Jersey to each conduct a study of certain bridges spanning bodies of water connected to deep water ports in the state to determine whether such bridges have the structural integrity to withstand an impact from large vessels such as cargo ships, oil tankers and cruise ships; requires a report and recommendations; provides for the repeal of such provisions upon the expiration thereof.

sponsored.t: Relates to consideration of capital expenditures in rate proceedings
sponsored.sum: Requires that any proposed capital expenditure to be considered in any matter affecting a major change in rates must be described by the utility on a per project basis and shall include the purpose and the need for each capital expenditure, total cost, and benefits to the ratepayers and the operation of the distribution system, and shall be posted on the PSC website.

sponsored.t: Extends the term and authority of the independent monitor for the Orange county industrial development agency and modifies the applicability of certain tax exemptions based on population
sponsored.sum: Extends the term and authority of the independent monitor for the Orange county industrial development agency; requires such monitor also monitor the Orange county funding corporation; modifies the applicability of certain tax exemptions based on population; extends provisions of law related to the independent monitor for the Orange county industrial development agency.

sponsored.t: Relates to food product price gouging
sponsored.sum: Provides that no party within the chain of distribution of food and food products shall sell or offer to sell any such goods for an amount which represents an unconscionably excessive price; provides a legal remedy; authorizes the attorney general to promulgate such rules and regulations.

sponsored.t: Prohibits sewage, wastewater and soil amendment pollution; relates to the disposition of funds from civil penalties
sponsored.sum: Prohibits any person or entity from spreading sewage, wastewater or soil amendment products containing sewage, wastewater, or compost from sewage sludge on lands in the state or from selling or distributing the same; requires that penalties from violations be deposited into the environmental protection fund.

sponsored.t: Relates to the the deadline for filing a certification required to be eligible for voluntary public financing or withdraw from the program
sponsored.sum: Requires the candidate certification required to be eligible for voluntary public financing to be submitted no later than thirty days after the last day to file designating petitions if another candidate for the same position files a designating petition, or no later than thirty days after the last day to file independent nominating petitions, if a candidate files an independent nominating petition for the same position; provides for the withdrawal by a candidate from the public financing program.

sponsored.t: Relates to allowing county clerks to notify property owners of the recording of certain documents in counties outside the city of New York
sponsored.sum: Requires the commissioner of the department of taxation and finance to establish and maintain a system for use by the clerk of each county in the state outside of the city of New York that provides the ability for the clerk to send notification to any interested party that a deed-related or mortgage-related document affecting such party's interest in real property located in the state has been recorded against such property with the office of the clerk of the county in which the real property is situated; provides for registration for notification by interested parties.

sponsored.t: Relates to public financing contributions that are not matchable for purposes of public financing
sponsored.sum: Provides that election contributions made in cash, or in bitcoin or any other form of cryptocurrency are not matchable for purposes of public financing.

sponsored.t: Includes Stewart International Airport in the definition of covered airport location for the purposes of minimum wage rates
sponsored.sum: Includes Stewart International Airport in the definition of covered airport location for the purposes of minimum wage rates.

sponsored.t: Requiring that certain sellers of real property provide a certificate of occupancy to the purchaser of the real property
sponsored.sum: Requires certain sellers of real property to provide a certificate of occupancy to the purchaser of the real property.

sponsored.t: Includes Stewart International Airport in the definition of covered airport location for the purposes of minimum wage rates
sponsored.sum: Requires the department of health to develop rules for all courts in New York state to protect the court employees and the public from COVID-19.

sponsored.t: Prohibits sex offenders whose victim was a child and level 3 sex offenders from knowingly being within 1,000 feet of a child care provider, preschool or any pre-kindergarten or kindergarten
sponsored.sum: Prohibits a sex offender whose victim was a child and level 3 sex offenders from knowingly being within 1,000 feet of a child care provider, preschool or any facility where pre-kindergarten or kindergarten instruction is provided.

sponsored.t: Relates to the substitution of brand name epinephrine auto-injectors with alternate epinephrine auto-injectors
sponsored.sum: Relates to the substitution of brand name epinephrine auto-injectors with alternate epinephrine auto-injectors in certain cases.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the city of Poughkeepsie to alienate and discontinue the use of certain parklands
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the city of Poughkeepsie to alienate and discontinue the use of certain parklands for the purpose of constructing a new emergency services communications tower.

sponsored.t: Establishes procedures to disassemble and dispose of guns purchased by local municipalities and law enforcement agencies through a gun buyback program
sponsored.sum: Establishes procedures to disassemble and dispose of guns, rifles and firearms purchased by local municipalities and law enforcement agencies through a gun buyback program, including the creation of a log and video recordings.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the City of Newburgh to add unpaid housing code violation penalties, costs and fines to such city's annual tax levy
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the City of Newburgh to add unpaid housing code violation penalties, costs and fines to such city's annual tax levy in accordance with applicable law.

sponsored.t: Establishes timelines for payment of election inspectors
sponsored.sum: Establishes timelines for payment of election inspectors.

sponsored.t: Requires the Thruway Authority to provide at least twelve charging stations at each rest area and gas station complex
sponsored.sum: Requires the Thruway Authority to provide at least twelve charging stations at each rest area and gas station complex owned, leased or operated by the Thruway Authority.

sponsored.t: Requires utility companies to report on utility poles and remove unused utility poles in the public right-of-way
sponsored.sum: Requires utility companies to report on utility poles and remove unused utility poles in the public right-of-way.

sponsored.t: Directs the New York State Department of Transportation to promulgate rules and regulations for the standardization of public charging stations for electric vehicles
sponsored.sum: Directs the New York State Department of Transportation, in conjunction with the New York State Energy Research and Development Authority and the New York Power Authority, to promulgate rules and regulations for the standardization of public charging stations for electric vehicles.

sponsored.t: Requires the state to provide reimbursement of certain costs and benefits incurred as a result of an injury occurring during a mutual aid call
sponsored.sum: Requires the state to provide reimbursement of certain costs and benefits incurred as a result of an injury occurring during a mutual aid call.

sponsored.t: Relates to reimbursement for students attending a boards of cooperative educational services program
sponsored.sum: Provides reimbursement to districts for any student attending a boards of cooperative educational services program.

sponsored.t: Relates to prohibiting fraudulent absentee ballot drop-off boxes or receptacles
sponsored.sum: Prohibits fraudulent absentee ballot drop-off boxes or receptacles by making it a felony for anyone other than the board of elections to erect, display or maintain an absentee ballot drop-off box or receptacle.

sponsored.t: Relates to updating the driver's manual provided to accepted learner's permit applicants and driver education courses
sponsored.sum: Relates to updating the driver's manual provided to accepted learner's permit applicants and driver education courses to include a description of law enforcement procedures during traffic stops and the actions a motorist shall take during such stop including appropriate interactions with such officers.

sponsored.t: Allows delivery of an application for an absentee ballot to the board of elections through and on the day of the election
sponsored.sum: Allows delivery of an application for an absentee ballot to the board of elections through and on the day of the election.

sponsored.t: Requires that internet providers who provide service in a municipality provide basic internet service to each residential dwelling or residential dwelling unit in that municipality at no cost
sponsored.sum: Requires that internet providers who provide service in a municipality provide basic internet service to each residential dwelling or residential dwelling unit in that municipality at no cost.

sponsored.t: Requires hospitals and medical facilities to notify nursing homes or assisted living facilities of a positive COVID-19 test result for a resident of such nursing home or assisted living facility
sponsored.sum: Requires hospitals and medical facilities to notify nursing homes or assisted living facilities upon receipt of a positive COVID-19 test result for a resident of such nursing home or assisted living facility; provides penalties for violations.

sponsored.t: Relates to aggravated sexual abuse in the fourth degree and creating a private right of action for fertility fraud; relates to the statute of limitations for such claim
sponsored.sum: Creates a private right of action for fertility fraud; adds a health care practitioner using human reproductive material from the practitioner or from a donor knowing or who reasonably should have known that such patient had not expressly consented to such use, to the crime of aggravated sexual abuse in the fourth degree; relates to the time in which to commence actions relating to fertility fraud; includes fertility fraud in the definition of professional misconduct for physicians, physician's assistants and specialist assistants.

sponsored.t: Relates to the definition of population for purposes of providing substantially equal weight for the population of that local government in the allocation of representation in the local legislative body
sponsored.sum: Relates to the definition of "population" for purposes of providing substantially equal weight for the population of that local government in the allocation of representation in the local legislative body.

sponsored.t: Permits union free and central school district boards of education to establish wards for the purpose of school board elections in Orange County
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the boards of education in union free school districts and central school districts to establish wards for the purpose of school board elections in Orange County.

sponsored.t: Requires that subpoenas relating to election matters be served with a separate informational sheet that summarizes why the subpoena has been issued
sponsored.sum: Requires that subpoenas issued relating to election matters be served with a separate informational sheet that summarizes why the subpoena has been issued.

sponsored.t: Establishes the task force on education funding and property tax reform
sponsored.sum: Establishes the task force on education funding and property tax reform within the education department to conduct a comprehensive study and provide recommendations on education funding and the role of property taxes in funding New York's education system.

sponsored.t: Provides for a partial real property tax exemption for the water filtration plant for the City of Newburgh, Orange County, New York
sponsored.sum: Provides for a partial real property tax exemption for the water filtration plant for the City of Newburgh, Orange County, New York.

sponsored.t: Relates to the state and municipal facilities program
sponsored.ls: New York State Urban Development Corporation Act
sponsored.sum: Requires state and municipal facilities program grants be issued only with governor, senate or assembly sponsor.

sponsored.t: Relates to county committees meeting no earlier than one day after the June primary is certified
sponsored.sum: Requires that county committees meet no earlier than one day after the June primary is certified.

sponsored.t: Requires that candidates for certain offices be residents and registered voters in the district containing the public office or party position sought at certain times during the electoral process
sponsored.sum: Requires that candidates for certain offices be residents and registered voters in the district containing the public office or party position sought at certain times during the electoral process.

sponsored.t: Rules and regulations requiring nursing homes and residential health care facilities to test all residents of such nursing homes and residential healthcare facilities for the novel coronavirus (COVID-19)
sponsored.sum: Requires the commissioner of health to promulgate rules and regulations requiring nursing homes and residential health care facilities to test all residents of such nursing homes and residential healthcare facilities for the novel coronavirus (COVID-19).

sponsored.t: Requires high schools to provide a course in financial literacy and requires students to complete such course as a condition of graduation
sponsored.sum: Requires high schools in grades nine through twelve to provide a course in financial literacy; requires students to complete such course as a condition of graduation.

sponsored.t: Increases the minimum insurance coverage required for motor vehicles registered and/or operated within the state of New York
sponsored.sum: Increases the minimum insurance coverage required for motor vehicles registered and/or operated within the state of New York; for injury or death to one person in any one accident, increases the limits required from $25,000 to $50,000 for bodily injury and from $50,000 to $100,000 for death, for injury or death to more than one person in any one accident, increases the limits required from $50,000 to $100,000 for bodily injury and from $100,000 to $200,000 for death, and for third party property damage in any one accident, increases the limits required from $10,000 to $25,000.

sponsored.t: Expands eligibility for the New York state excelsior scholarship award to certain applicants enrolled on a part-time basis or in a BOCES or other approved vocational program
sponsored.sum: Expands eligibility for the New York state excelsior scholarship award to certain applicants enrolled on a part-time basis or in a BOCES or other approved vocational program; provides criteria for eligibility, and limits on amounts and durations for any such awards.

sponsored.t: Relates to prohibition of certain activities in extreme temperatures
sponsored.sum: Prohibits a retail business from directing an employee to engage in human billboard activities during extreme temperatures.

sponsored.t: Relates to the payment of fees allowed for representation in unemployment compensation cases
sponsored.sum: Allows approved claims of representatives for services rendered to a claimant in connection with an unemployment insurance claim to become a lien upon the benefit allowed; criminalizes certain violations relating to other forms of compensation in connection with an unemployment insurance claim; provides that a fee allowed shall be on a contingency basis and be equal to fifteen percent of the amount of the benefits to be paid to the claimant at the conclusion of services rendered.

sponsored.t: Directs the public service commission to formulate a process, rules and regulations for the regulation of the charges and fees of internet and cable providers
sponsored.sum: Directs the public service commission to formulate a process, rules and regulations for the regulation of the charges and fees of internet and cable providers.

sponsored.t: Requires employees and independent contractors to notify employers and contractors upon receiving a positive result of a test for COVID-19 and provides penalties for violations
sponsored.sum: Requires employees and independent contractors to notify employers and contractors within three hours after receiving a positive result of a test for COVID-19; provides penalties for violations.

sponsored.t: Makes commissioners full time employees of boards outside the city of New York
sponsored.sum: Makes commissioners full time employees of boards outside the city of New York.

sponsored.t: Enables public authorities to transmit electronic notifications to E-ZPass customers
sponsored.sum: Enables public authorities that offer E-ZPass payment for tolls, fares, fees, rentals or other charges to transmit electronic notifications stating that the electronic toll collection system has registered the customer's account to E-ZPass customers who opt in for such service.

sponsored.t: Moves the date of the presidential primary to the same date as the state primaries
sponsored.sum: Moves the date of the presidential primary to the same date as the state primaries.

sponsored.t: Requires entities receiving state funding for workforce development purposes to annually file a report with the department of labor
sponsored.sum: Requires entities receiving state funding for workforce development purposes to annually file a report with the department of labor describing the number of individuals contacted, trained and hired by such entities and the status of such individuals at 6, 12, 18 and 24 months after hiring.

sponsored.t: Provides for a separate line at polling places for persons with disabilities
sponsored.sum: Provides for a separate line at polling places for persons with disabilities.

sponsored.t: Relates to the unlawful wearing of body armor
sponsored.sum: Relates to the unlawful wearing of a body vest; provides that a person is guilty of the unlawful wearing of a body vest when such person commits a certain misdemeanor or felony and in the course of and in furtherance of such crime such person wears a body vest.

sponsored.t: Directs the state board of elections to create a plan to permit voting by mail in the event of a natural disaster or state of emergency
sponsored.sum: Directs the state board of elections to create a plan to permit voting by mail in the event of a natural disaster or state of emergency.

sponsored.t: Relates to the taxation of certain lands in the city of Beacon and town of Fishkill in Dutchess county
sponsored.sum: Provides for the taxation of all lands owned by the state, exclusive of the improvements erected thereon by the state, in the city of Beacon and the town of Fishkill in Dutchess county.

sponsored.t: Eliminates the ability of judicial candidates enrolled in a particular party to automatically be allowed to run as a candidate in another party's primary election
sponsored.sum: Eliminates the ability of judicial candidates for office who are enrolled in a particular party to automatically be allowed to run as a candidate in another party's primary election.

sponsored.t: Requires motor vehicle dealers to disclose price markups to the purchasers of motor vehicles
sponsored.sum: Requires motor vehicle dealers to disclose price markups to the purchasers of motor vehicles; provides failure to so disclose shall be grounds for revocation of the dealer's registration and imposes civil liability to purchasers for damages; authorizes the financial frauds and consumer protection unit of the department of financial services to study problematic practices in the price markups of motor vehicle dealers.

sponsored.t: Designates certain streets in the city of Newburgh as state highways
sponsored.sum: Designates Broadway and Lake Street in the city of Newburgh as state highways.

sponsored.t: Designates certain streets in the city of Newburgh as state highways
sponsored.sum: Designates Water Street, Leroy Place, North Street, Plank Road, and South Street in the city of Newburgh as state highways.

sponsored.t: Relates to recurring contributions solicited by a candidate, political campaign, political committee, party committee, or not-for-profit or for-profit entity
sponsored.sum: Provides that entities soliciting a recurring contribution to a political campaign, political committee, party committee, or not-for-profit or for-profit entity shall receive the affirmative consent of the contributor at the time of arrangement of the recurring contribution; provides for refund of recurring contributions; provides penalties for violations.

sponsored.t: Permits union free and central school district boards of education to establish wards for the purpose of school board elections
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the boards of education in union free school districts and central school districts to establish wards for the purpose of school board elections.

sponsored.t: Authorizes municipalities in the county of Orange to add unpaid housing code violation penalties, costs and fines to such municipalities' annual tax levy
sponsored.sum: Authorizes municipalities in the county of Orange to add unpaid housing code violation penalties, costs and fines to such municipalities' annual tax levy in accordance with applicable law.

sponsored.t: Withdraws Orange county from the metropolitan commuter transportation district
sponsored.sum: Withdraws Orange county from the metropolitan commuter transportation district.

sponsored.t: Caps certain public utility profit margins at four percent
sponsored.sum: Caps public gas corporations, public electric corporations and municipal gas and electric companies at a profit margin of four percent per year.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the public service commission to consider non-economic loss suffered by consumers when determining penalties
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the public service commission to consider non-economic loss suffered by consumers, including pain and suffering or mental anguish, when determining penalties against a public utility company, corporation or person or a combination gas and electric corporation.

sponsored.t: Relates to the date a change in voter enrollment becomes effective
sponsored.sum: Provides that a change in voter enrollment made after February 14th and before or on seven days after the last day to file the authorization certificate of nomination made at a caucus shall take effect on the seventh day after the last day to file the certificate of nomination made at a caucus.

sponsored.t: Prohibits electric corporations and gas corporations from increasing charges due to the building or operation of a data center
sponsored.sum: Prohibits electric corporations and gas corporations from passing along costs or increasing charges to ratepayers as a result of increased costs incurred due to the building or operation of a data center except to those ratepayers involved with or associated with the building or operation of such data center or semiconductor fabrication plant.

sponsored.t: Relates to prohibiting the sale of food or beverages containing kratom and 7-hydroxymitragynine
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the sale or offering for sale, delivery or manufacture of food or beverages containing kratom or its derivatives, or 7-hydroxymitragynine; provides penalties.

sponsored.t: Relates to designating the fourth Thursday in March as "Tuskegee Airmen Commemoration Day"
sponsored.sum: Designates the fourth Thursday in March as "Tuskegee Airmen Commemoration Day".

sponsored.t: Relates to limiting rate increases that entail a return on equity for capital projects
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the public service commission from approving a rate increase that entails a return on equity for capital projects that is above the prevailing ten-year treasury rate plus one percent.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the New York State Energy Research and Development Authority to loan money to utility companies for purposes of capital expenditures
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the New York State Energy Research and Development Authority to loan money to utility companies for purposes of capital expenditures; authorizes the issuance of bonds.

sponsored.t: Relates to the filing of a declination to a designation or nomination
sponsored.sum: Provides that a person who did not receive the nomination of a party in a caucus, may file a certificate of declination to a designation or nomination with respect to that office which the person had filed a designating petition of another party or had received the nomination after a primary or to a nomination of another party decided at a caucus within ten days after the certificate of nomination made pursuant to the caucus which the person had lost is filed.

sponsored.t: Relates to consideration of capital expenditures in rate proceedings
sponsored.sum: Requires that any proposed capital expenditure to be considered in any matter affecting a major change in rates must be described by the utility and shall include the purpose, cost, and benefits to the ratepayers and shall be posted on the PSC website.

appr.text: APPROVAL MEMORANDUM - No. 17 Chapter 622 MEMORANDUM filed with Assembly Bill Number 2736-A, entitled: "AN ACT to amend the public service law, in relation to consider- ation of capital expenditures in utility rate proceedings" APPROVED This bill would require the Public Service Commission (PSC) to post on its website a description of any proposed capital expenditure to be considered in any matter affecting a major change in rates, including the proposed project's purpose, total cost, expected period of useful- ness, location, and anticipated benefits to ratepayers. I am steadfast in my commitment to affordability. It is essential that the PSC have all the information it needs from utilities in rate cases where ratepayers would be impacted so that it can closely scrutinize all relevant information. However, the bill required modifications to make it clear that utilities must provide this…

sponsored.t: Extends the authority of the town of Newburgh to impose a hotel and motel tax
sponsored.sum: Extends the authority of the town of Newburgh to impose a hotel and motel tax for an additional two years; makes a technical change.

sponsored.t: Makes a technical change to the tax law; extends the city of Newburgh occupancy tax
sponsored.sum: Makes a technical change to the tax law; authorizes the imposition of an occupancy tax in the city of Newburgh, in relation of the effectiveness thereof.

sponsored.t: Permits the rendering of an estimated bill from a utility corporation or municipality under certain circumstances
sponsored.sum: Permits the rendering of an estimated bill from a utility corporation or municipality under certain circumstances; requires each utility corporation and municipality within six months to submit to the commission a model for the calculation of and procedures for estimated bills that incorporates best practices and technology and accounts for any barriers to the use of actual meter readings.

sponsored.t: Relates to manufactured homes certificate of title and the conveyance and encumbrance of manufactured homes as real property
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "New York land-home property act"; relates to manufactured homes certificate of title and the conveyance and encumbrance of manufactured homes as real property.

sponsored.t: Relates to permitting candidates to be employed by a board of elections
sponsored.sum: Permits a candidate for office to be employed by a board of elections with prior authorization and a majority vote of the elections commissioners.
